faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SKIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SKIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 1 Project Research Scientist - II (Non-Medical), 1 Project Technical Support - II, 2 Project Nurse - I.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for SKIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Requisite application format stated as attached to the advertisement) and send it to Office of Dr. Kaneez Fatima, Principal Investigator, Addl. Professor, Radiation Oncology, Sher-I-Kashmir Institute of Medical Sciences, Srinagar, to reach by 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: As per latest ICMR/DHR Norms for Project Research Scientist - II (Non-Medical), As per latest ICMR/DHR Norms for Project Technical Support - II, As per latest ICMR/DHR Norms for Project Nurse - I.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Project Research Scientist - II: First class PG degree with 3 years' experience or PhD, or second class PG degree with PhD and 3 years' experience. Project Technical Support - II: 12th in science + Diploma in MLT/DMLT or equivalent with 5 years' research experience. Project Nurse - I: Two-year GNM course from a recognized university. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Qualification and experience should be from any Govt. recognized reputed organization. Experience will be counted only after completion of minimum education qualification.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting. Interview. Date and venue of interview communicated to shortlisted candidates via phone or the SKIMS website www.skims.ac.in. Recruitment through the duly constituted Selection Committee for extramural research projects.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Posts filled purely on temporary basis. Project initially for 12 months, extendable up to 3 years on the basis of performance. No claim for regular appointment at the institute after termination of the project.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: SKIMS, Srinagar.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Application in the requisite format; Attested copies of certificates/documents.
